scope: Original remaining worker-strategy round; structural tool cardinality and unchanged resource/quality bindings only.

openBlockers.finding: The normal provider interface permits exactly one deferred action per response. Designation, resolution and same-source execution are separate host actions; designation first requires a current-turn verified save. A final action-free response is also required.

necessaryUnchangedPhaseGates: Do not repeat, resume or rearm the closed first baseline. Keep its native failure, 3/3 separate source checks and measured usage.
Before the unstarted second baseline, resolve actual structural feasibility under the registered limits; do not amend questions, oracles, quality criteria or counts to fabricate a viable result.

Admit only the original second-baseline identity after a source-bound feasibility/admission decision; current source/control hashes and actual owner/source/stop/profile guards must hold before dispatch.

Seal both original baseline records once, including fully measured physical usage and exact task/session/ingress/source/readback receipts. Compose DevelopmentAssessment afresh after both reference files exist; never adopt them lazily.

Use at most one native candidate construction with only the literal <=4096UTF8 strategy body changed. Host validates outside bytes and binds the exact candidate once without replacing old ledger usage.

Use the same future client/profile, roles, grants, fixtures and fixed two-case development sample for both sources. Compare actual completed tasks, behavior and needed human assistance; no resource-only or keyword gain.

Proceed only on strict quality improvement without per-case regression or hard-boundary failure. Keep baseline on tie/loss/invalid evidence. Unknown usage, scope drift, revoked authority, stop or a shared measured overrun closes further dispatch.

Run only the registered separate protected final baseline/finalist sample after exact runtime/admission binding; keep protected questions/scorer isolated and every consumed scope/old receipt bytefixed.
Apply once only after independent acceptance. Later ordinary use requires the actual candidate source installed and exact release parity, and actual results/readbacks without new implementation.
No whole-goal/full-AIDE2, family acceptance, superiority or efficiency claim follows from this bounded round.

earlyStop.originalRuleUnchanged: Both development baseline cases at quality maximum and zero help imply no candidate/final/later necessity.

smallestActionableBoundary.decision: Keep the unstarted multistep/candidate/final/later phases closed. The actual blocker is ordinary single-action interaction cardinality, not missing protected cases, a new optimizer or a scorer defect.
smallestActionableBoundary.neededBeforePaidContinuation: A legitimate product/registration decision must make the unchanged ordinary multi-step contract feasible. This review grants neither a higher resource ceiling nor a batching implementation.
